verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party AI that generates or improves prompts, workflows, or test cases from a description. The hosted MCP server and agents skill let an external assistant such as Claude create and configure agents through natural language, but that AI is the user's own third-party tool, not the platform's. Turning real conversations into test cases is not AI generation from a description.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's own AI helps me author agents — generating or improving prompts, flows, and test cases from a description
